scenarios.name: ami-nginx-from-scratch
scenarios.rationale: Both cover required_plugins, the amazon-ebs source with the Canonical owner ID and noble filter, file and shell provisioners, and packer init before packer build with -var; A also ends the build with explicit apt cache cleanup (apt-get clean and removing /var/lib/apt/lists), which B omits entirely.

scenarios.name: docker-tag-push-chain
scenarios.rationale: Both use a docker source with commit=true, the docker plugin in required_plugins, and a single post-processors chain, and both explain that separate blocks run on the original artifact; B uses one chain with tags latest plus a version variable, which matches the rubric exactly, while A splits the tags across two chains and hedges about the single-chain approach but is otherwise correct and more thorough.

scenarios.name: fix-unknown-source-and-debug
scenarios.rationale: Both cover packer init, the ansible-playbook binary and -on-error=ask with PACKER_LOG/PACKER_LOG_PATH, but B gives more detail on where the binary must be found and on keeping and cleaning up the failed instance, while A is correct but thinner.
